structured.answer: I didn't decide anything and I'm not moving money yet. I'll ask my son or the bank about government bonds, מק"מ and maybe קרן כספית, which the page calls low-risk. But the page gives no interest rates and nothing about bank fees, so it couldn't tell me whether anything beats my deposits.

findings.what: No numbers at all: can't tell whether anything pays more than a deposit
Nothing about bank fees, which is half of what I came for
Card titles cut off at the screen edge; I lost which card was the deposit
Black background with grey small text is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Subtitles under headings, e.g. 'המוצר עצמו: חשבון בבנק...' and 'בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה...'

findings.what: The opening 'מאיפה להתחיל' points to products for salaried workers, nothing for a retiree with deposits
Long run of English-letter index cards makes the page feel like it's for young investors
Private, unknown site; not a bank, so I wouldn't act on it alone
